description: This file defines a React functional component 'StoryViewPage' responsible for displaying user stories with progress indicators, navigation, and user info. It fetches story data from a backend service and manages story progression and user interactions.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: React hook to handle side effects: fetch story data on userId change and set up the story progress timer.

methods.name: fetchStory
methods.description: Asynchronous function to retrieve story and user data from backend.

methods.name: handleNextStory
methods.description: Advances to the next story or navigates home if at the end.

methods.name: handlePrevStory
methods.description: Goes back to the previous story if possible.

methods.name: handleTap
methods.description: Handles user tap to determine navigation based on tap position.
